reason: My leads come from posting and comment-to-DM, and cold DMs are only a side thing when the pipeline's thin. If I'm stuck it's my offer or my content, not that I can't send enough DMs, so $147 a month for more outreach doesn't fix my actual problem.

would_change_my_mind: Real case studies from agencies my size showing booked calls from this, plus a longer trial or a refund window, or a much lower price like $49 a month.
